newsitem.title: THAILAND: Thai interbank rate, baht steady in late trade.
newsitem.headline: Thai interbank rate, baht steady in late trade.

text.p: The Thai overnight interbank rate stayed largely unchanged in the 13.50-14.00 percent range near the Tuesday close on moderate liquidity but limited market activity, dealers said.

Dealers said a reported deadlock on efforts of Thailand's ruling coalition parties to choose a leader by replace Prime Minister Banharn Silpa-archa triggered a brief round of buying dollars and baht-dollar forward swap contracts in the afternoon.
"The forex market was a touch more active in the afternoon, helped by reports on the deadlock to pick a new prime minister," a foreign bank dealer said.
The baht was quoted at 25.373-25.377 against the dollar late in the afternoon from 25.370-25.380 in the morning.
The one-month dollar/baht swap premium rose to 11.00-11.50 satangs per dollar in late trade from 11.00-11.25 in the morning and 10.00-10.50 late on Monday.
The central bank on Tuesday fixed the baht/dollar midrate at 25.38 against 25.39 on Monday.
